title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
abstract: arXiv:2610.27954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large (vision) language models have enabled computer-use agents that automate digital workflows via fine-grained keyboard and mouse operations. However, such agents remain fragile in long-horizon settings, where errors accumulate and executed actions leave unintended side effects, making the ability to recover from failures critical. Yet, existing remedies remain inadequate: environment resets are infeasible in proprietary settings, action replay is prohibitively expensive over long horizons, and API-based rollback is limited to web environments, leaving model-based recovery largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ReTrace, a scalable evaluation framework for systematically studying recovery behavior in computer-use agents. We formalize Transition-Consistent Recovery: identical downstream actions from the recovered and target states must yield identical outcomes. We operationalize this criterion through goal

translated_title: 迷失于恢复之中：通过面向目标的动作回放揭示计算机使用智能体的恢复行为
translated_abstract: 近期大（视觉）语言模型的进展使计算机使用智能体能够通过细粒度的键盘和鼠标操作自动完成数字工作流程。然而，这类智能体在长时程任务中仍然十分脆弱：误差不断累积，已执行的动作会留下意想不到的副作用，因此从失败中恢复的能力至关重要。然而，现有的补救手段仍不充分：环境重置在专有环境中不可行，动作回放在长时程下代价过于高昂，基于API的回滚又仅限于网页环境，这使得基于模型的恢复方法在很大程度上尚未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ReTrace，一个用于系统研究计算机使用智能体恢复行为的可扩展评估框架。我们将“转换一致的恢复”形式化为一个判定标准：从恢复后的状态与目标状态出发执行相同的下游动作，必须产生相同的结果。我们通过面向目标的（动作回放）将这一标准加以操作化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ReTrace评估框架，通过形式化“转换一致的恢复”标准并借助面向目标的动作回放，系统性地评估计算机使用智能体从失败中恢复的能力，填补了基于模型的恢复研究的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ReTrace, a scalable evaluation framework that formalizes Transition-Consistent Recovery and operationalizes it via goal-oriented action replay, enabling systematic study of how computer-use agents recover from failures.
